limitations: No physical-device, Bluetooth, lock-screen or storage-eviction test was run.
Classifications and discovery presentation have not received owner/expert biological review.
Annual profiles are aggregated 2016–2025 reporting frequencies; no year-over-year population trend or arrival/departure inference is made.
Regional support is county-bin checklist sample weighting, not a count of independent birding events.
No production deployment is claimed by this local evidence file.
